parameters.name: AccountName
parameters.description:
The name of the database account.

>  If you do not specify this parameter, the information about all database accounts is returned.

parameters.name: AccountType
parameters.description:
The type of the database account. If you do not specify this parameter, the information about all account types is returned. Valid values:

*   **Normal**: standard account.
*   **Super**: privileged account.

parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters within a region.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun adb describe-accounts --db-cluster-id amv-bp11q28kvl6880000 --account-name test_accout --tags Value=low_env Key=AnalyticDB_IO_UTIL --account-type Super --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun adb DescribeAccounts --region cn-hangzhou --Tags.1.Value low_env --DBClusterId 'amv-bp11q28kvl6880000' --Tags.1.Key AnalyticDB_IO_UTIL --AccountType Super --AccountName test_accout
